target: tracker.sh advance — Guard B, a returning stage cannot silently undo a shelve
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: raced
status: building
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; TRACKER_FORCE_LIVE=1 tracker_shelve factory/specs/001-a.md human 'no longer needed' >/dev/null; if ( tracker_advance factory/specs/001-a.md built branch claude/idea-raced ) >/dev/null 2>&1; then EC=0; else EC=$?; fi; if ( TRACKER_FORCE_LIVE=1 tracker_advance factory/specs/001-a.md built ) >/dev/null 2>&1; then F=0; else F=$?; fi; jq -n --argjson ec "$EC" --argjson f "$F" --arg st "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" '{ec: $ec, f: $f, st: $st}'
_note: the race this guard exists for: a human shelves a spec while its build stage is still running; that stage finishes and calls `advance <file> built`, which without the guard reverts the human's decision leaving no trace at all. First assertion: the unaware stage is refused. Second: an operator who knows what they are doing can still force it, so the guard is a gate and not a wall.
